title: Personal Credit Cards: rewards program, earning rates, bonus categories and quarterly bonus cap by tier
content:
# Personal Credit Cards: rewards earning rates by tier

This comparison table covers rewards earning on the Personal Credit Cards line: which rewards currency each tier uses, the points earned per whole dollar of net purchases outside and inside the bonus categories, which merchant categories are bonus categories, and how much bonus-category spending per calendar quarter earns the bonus rate.

## Tier table

| Card tier | Rewards currency | Base rate (points per whole dollar) | Bonus categories | Bonus rate (points per whole dollar) | Bonus-category spending per calendar quarter at the bonus rate |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Secured Visa | none | 0 | none | 0 | not applicable |
| College Rewards Visa | cash back | 1 | dining, grocery | 2 | 1000.00 USD |
| Platinum Low Rate Visa | none | 0 | none | 0 | not applicable |
| Cash Rewards Visa | cash back | 1.5 | grocery, gas, dining | 3 | 2500.00 USD |
| Travel Rewards Visa Signature | points | 1 | travel, dining | 3 | no cap |
| Visa Infinite Private Client | points | 1.5 | travel, dining | 3 | no cap |

## What the columns mean

- **Rewards currency**: none, cash back or points.
- **Base rate**: points earned per whole dollar of net purchases outside the bonus categories.
- **Bonus categories**: the merchant categories that earn the bonus rate.
- **Bonus rate**: points earned per whole dollar of net purchases in the bonus categories, up to the quarterly cap.
- **Quarterly cap**: the bonus-category purchases per calendar quarter that earn the bonus rate; "no cap" means the bonus rate has no quarterly ceiling on that tier.

## Equivalent reading

- Secured Visa and Platinum Low Rate Visa have no rewards program, so every rate is 0 and no category earns a bonus.
- College Rewards Visa and Cash Rewards Visa are the cash back tiers and both cap bonus-category spending per quarter.
- Travel Rewards Visa Signature and Visa Infinite Private Client are the points tiers; their bonus rate on travel and dining has no quarterly cap.

## Basis Q&A

**Q: Is gas a bonus category on College Rewards Visa?**
A: No. College Rewards Visa's bonus categories are dining and grocery only; gas is a bonus category on Cash Rewards Visa.
